blocks.text: Yeh chapter 7 (Hypothesis Testing) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 8 number ka hai (definition, misalon ke saath wazahat, farq, program likh kar samjhana), aksar definition aur wazahat ke hisson mein (jaise 2 + 3 x 2). Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Differentiate between a hypothesis and hypothesis testing (4). Write the hypothesis function hθ(x) = y and explain each of its symbols (4). (8 marks)
(Hypothesis aur hypothesis testing mein farq likhein (4). Hypothesis function hθ(x) = y likh kar is ki har alamat samjhayein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Part 1: table dekhein.

Part 2: hθ(x) = y
hθ(x): parameters θ ke saath input x par lagaya gaya hypothesis function.
x: input features ya data points, maslan dataset ki attributes (khasusiyat).
y: predicted output ya target value, yani diye gaye input ke liye model ki peshgoi.
θ: model ke parameters ya weights (wazan), maslan linear regression model ke coefficients.

book_ref.quote: The statement can be tested using data.

rows: Research mein testing se pehle banaya gaya mafroza ya bayan.
Data se faisle karne ka tareeqa; check karta hai ke mafroza sahi hai ya ghalat.
Population, halat ya variables ke talluq ke baare mein testable bayan.
Statistical tareeqa jo dekhta hai ke sample data mein daawe ki himayat ya radd ke liye kafi saboot hai ya nahin.
Nateeje ki peshgoi karta hai; wazeh aur measurable ho.
Wazeh amal par chalta hai jo mafroze qubool ya radd karne mein madad deta hai.
Analysis ki rehnumai aur study ko markooz karta hai.
Andaza kam aur saboot par mabni faisle karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2 Explain the connection between research questions and hypotheses in four points (4). For the research questions 'Does a new teaching method improve students' marks?' and 'Is a new drug more effective than an old drug?', write H₀ and H₁ (4). (8 marks)
(Research questions aur hypotheses ka talluq chaar nukaat mein samjhayein (4). Research questions 'Kya naya teaching method students ke marks behtar karta hai?' aur 'Kya nayi dawai purani se zyada moassar hai?' ke liye H₀ aur H₁ likhein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Part 1:
1. Research questions batate hain ke kya study ho raha hai, aur hypothesis research question se banta hai.
2. Sawal data collection ki rehnumai karte hain, jab ke hypotheses mumkina jawab dete hain.
3. Wazeh sawal wazeh hypotheses dete hain; achhi research achhe sawalon se shuru hoti hai.
4. Dono gehra talluq rakhte hain: hypotheses analysis ko markooz karte aur study ki simt behtar karte hain.

Part 2:
Teaching method: H₀: Naye teaching method ka students ke marks par koi asar nahin. H₁: Naya teaching method students ke marks behtar karta hai.
Nayi dawai: H₀: Nayi dawai purani se zyada moassar nahin (koi farq nahin). H₁: Nayi dawai purani se zyada moassar hai.

blocks.prompt:
3 Explain how hypothesis testing helps in data analysis under four headings: logic, avoiding random conclusions, accuracy, and confidence (8). (8 marks)
(Data analysis mein hypothesis testing ki madad chaar unwanat ke tehat samjhayein: mantiq, random nataij se bachao, durusti aur aitmaad (8).)
blocks.explanation:
1. Mantiq: hypothesis testing data ko mantiqi tor par parakh kar dekhta hai ke nataij ba-maani hain. Is ka wazeh amal hai jis mein data ehtiyat se jama aur analyze hota hai.

2. Random nataij se bachao: testing nataij ko tawaqqo se milati hai, andaze par nahin chalti, is liye random nataij se bachati hai.

3. Durusti: hypothesis testing accuracy ki himayat karta hai, isi liye experiments aur surveys mein istemal hota hai; nataij durust testing par munhasar hain.

4. Aitmaad: faisle saboot par hote hain, is liye yeh tareeqa nataij par aitmaad barhata hai aur evidence-based faislon ki himayat karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Hypothesis testing helps analyze data logically to check whether results are meaningful.

blocks.prompt:
4 Why do many tests start with the null hypothesis? Give four reasons (4). Explain the two possible decisions about H₀, 'reject' and 'fail to reject', with the decision rule and one example of each (4). (8 marks)
(Bohat se tests null hypothesis se kyun shuru hote hain? Chaar wajuhat likhein (4). H₀ ke baare mein do mumkina faisle, 'reject' aur 'fail to reject', decision rule aur aik aik misal ke saath samjhayein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Part 1:
1. H₀ kehta hai ke koi asar ya farq nahin, is liye yeh default mafroza hai.
2. Data isi hypothesis ke khilaf parakha jata hai.
3. Yeh muqable ki bunyad deta hai.
4. Yeh bias se bachata hai aur faisla sazi mein ahem hai.

Part 2: decision rule se faisla hota hai ke H₀ radd karna hai ya nahin: agar p-value < α to H₀ radd; warna H₀ radd nahin. Table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Many tests start with this hypothesis.

rows: p-value < α: H₀ ke khilaf saboot mazboot hai.
p-value ≥ α: H₀ ke khilaf saboot kafi nahin.
Nateeja ittefaq se aane ka imkaan kam; data H₁ ki himayat karta hai.
H₁ ki himayat ke liye kafi saboot nahin.
Misal: naya teaching method p = 0.03, α = 0.05; 0.03 < 0.05, is liye H₀ radd.
Misal: test p = 0.20, α = 0.05; 0.20 > 0.05, is liye H₀ radd nahin.

blocks.prompt:
5 Explain any four rules for formulating correct hypotheses (4). Point out what is wrong with each statement and rewrite it as a correct hypothesis: (A) 'Exercise is good.' (B) 'Students may do something better with computers.' (4) (8 marks)
(Durust hypotheses banane ke koi chaar usool samjhayein (4). Har bayan ki ghalti batayein aur use durust hypothesis ki shakal mein likhein: (A) 'Exercise achhi hai.' (B) 'Students computers ke saath kuch behtar kar sakte hain.' (4))
blocks.explanation:
Part 1:
1. Wazeh aur makhsoos: durust hypothesis wazeh aur specific ho, kyunke mubham bayan durusti kam karte hain.
2. Testable: data se test ho sake.
3. Mel: hypothesis research question se mel khaye.
4. Wazeh variables aur aasan zaban: variables wazeh bayan hon aur aasan zaban samajh barhati hai. Durust formulation waqt bachata hai aur qabil-e-aitmaad nataij deta hai.

Part 2:
(A) Mubham hai: 'achhi' measurable nahin aur koi variable bayan nahin. Durust: H₁: Rozana exercise students ke marks par numayan asar daalti hai; H₀: Rozana exercise ka marks par koi asar nahin.
(B) Mubham aur na-qabil-e-jaanch: 'kuch behtar' makhsoos nahin aur variable bayan nahin. Durust: H₁: Parhai ke liye computer istemal karne wale students ke marks na karne walon se zyada hain; H₀: Dono groups ke marks mein koi farq nahin.

blocks.prompt:
6 Define test statistics and give two of their uses (2). Write the formula of the t-value with its symbols (2). A sample of 36 students has an average score of 81 and a sample standard deviation of 12. Calculate t to test whether the mean is different from the population mean of 78 (4). (8 marks)
(Test statistics ki definition aur do faide likhein (2). t-value ka formula alamaat ke saath likhein (2). 36 students ke sample ka ausat score 81 aur sample standard deviation 12 hai. Population mean 78 se farq jaanchne ke liye t nikalein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Test statistics sample data se nikali gayi adadi qeematein hain; yeh data ke rawayye ka khulasa deti hain, nataij milane aur faisle mein madad karti hain, aur dikhati hain ke nataij tawaqqo se kitne door hain. Misalein t-value aur chi-square value.
Formula: t = (x̄ − μ₀)/(s/√n), jahan x̄ = sample mean, μ₀ = null hypothesis ke tehat population mean, s = sample standard deviation, n = sample size.

book_ref.quote: They are calculated from sample data.

steps: Diya gaya: n = 36, x̄ = 81, μ₀ = 78, s = 12.

blocks.prompt:
7 Write the chi-square formula and explain its symbols (2). A fair die is rolled 120 times and the faces 1 to 6 appear 18, 22, 20, 25, 15 and 20 times. Find the expected frequencies and calculate χ² (5). What is done with this value next? (1) (8 marks)
(Chi-square ka formula likh kar alamaat samjhayein (2). Aik fair dice 120 baar phenka gaya aur face 1 se 6 tak 18, 22, 20, 25, 15 aur 20 baar aaye. Expected frequencies nikal kar χ² hisaab karein (5). Is qeemat ke saath aage kya kiya jata hai? (1))
blocks.explanation: χ² = Σ (Oᵢ − Eᵢ)²/Eᵢ, jahan Oᵢ har category ki observed frequency aur Eᵢ expected frequency hai. (Book correction: alamat Greek harf chi, χ², hai, harf x nahin.) Chi-Square test talluqat check karta hai aur categorical data ke saath istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Observed and expected frequencies of a fair die rolled 60 times

steps: Fair dice ke 6 barabar imkaan wale face hain, is liye har face ke liye Eᵢ = 120/6 = 20.
Phir χ² ko chune gaye significance level (maslan α = 0.05) aur degrees of freedom par Chi-Square table ki critical value se mila kar faisla kiya jata hai.
blocks.final_answer: Har face ki expected frequency = 20; χ² = 2.9

blocks.prompt:
8 Define the critical region (2) and the significance level (2). Explain how the two are related and how they are used to make a decision (4). (8 marks)
(Critical region (2) aur significance level (2) ki definition likhein. Dono ka talluq aur faisle mein in ka istemal samjhayein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Critical region: qeematon ki range (statistical distribution ka woh hissa) jahan null hypothesis radd hota hai; agar test statistic is mein gire to H₀ radd. Yeh intehai nataij dikhata hai.

Significance level (α): H₀ asal mein sach ho phir bhi use radd karne ka zyada se zyada imkaan. Yeh ghalti ka khatra dikhata hai; aam qeemat 0.05.

Talluq aur istemal:
1. Dono testing se pehle tay hote hain: α analysis se pehle chuna jata hai aur critical region testing se pehle tay hota hai.
2. Critical region significance level par munhasar hai; α batata hai test kitna sakht hai, kam qeemat yani zyada sakht testing.
3. Test statistic nikalne ke baad faisla: agar woh critical region mein gire to H₀ radd; warna nahin. Isi tarah p-value ko α se milaya jata hai.
4. Dono mil kar faisla karne, ghair yaqeeniyat kam karne aur ghalat nataij qaboo karne mein madad dete hain; graphs aksar critical region dikhate hain.

book_ref.quote: The critical region is a range of values.

blocks.prompt:
9 Explain the p-value and its importance in four points (4). Write the decision in each case and give the reason: (A) p = 0.04, α = 0.05; (B) p = 0.09, α = 0.05; (C) p = 0.03, α = 0.01; (D) p = 0.002, α = 0.01 (4). (8 marks)
(p-value aur is ki ahmiyat chaar nukaat mein samjhayein (4). Har soorat mein faisla aur wajah likhein: (A) p = 0.04, α = 0.05; (B) p = 0.09, α = 0.05; (C) p = 0.03, α = 0.01; (D) p = 0.002, α = 0.01 (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Part 1:
1. p-value null hypothesis ke khilaf saboot ki taqat dikhata hai.
2. Yeh H₀ sach hone ki soorat mein dekhe gaye ya us se zyada intehai nataij aane ka imkaan (probability) naapta hai.
3. Chhota p-value H₀ ke radd ki himayat karta hai kyunke nateeja ittefaq se aana mushkil hai; ise significance level (maslan 0.05) se milaya jata hai.
4. p-values faislon ko aasan aur data par mabni banate hain; achhi samajh baghair saboot ke hypothesis qubool ya radd karne se bachati hai.

Part 2: table dekhein (usool: p-value < α ho to H₀ radd).

book_ref.quote: It measures the probability of getting the observed results, or more extreme results, if the null hypothesis is true.

rows: H₀ radd, kyunke 0.04 < 0.05.
H₀ radd nahin, kyunke 0.09 > 0.05.
H₀ radd nahin, kyunke 0.03 > 0.01; sakht test ko zyada mazboot saboot chahiye.
H₀ radd, kyunke 0.002 < 0.01.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Case (C) mein wahi p = 0.03 jo α = 0.05 par H₀ radd karta, α = 0.01 par kafi nahin, kyunke kam α ka matlab zyada sakht test hai.

blocks.prompt:
10 The previous average marks of a class were 60. After a new revision method, a sample of 5 students obtained 60, 64, 66, 62 and 68. Using α = 0.05, test whether the method has improved the marks. Statistical software gives the one-tailed p-value for the calculated t as about 0.024. Show all steps (8). (8 marks)
(Class ke pichhle ausat marks 60 the. Naye revision method ke baad 5 students ke sample ne 60, 64, 66, 62 aur 68 marks liye. α = 0.05 le kar jaanchein ke method ne marks behtar kiye ya nahin. Statistical software nikali gayi t ke liye one-tailed p-value taqreeban 0.024 deta hai. Tamam steps dikhayein (8).)
blocks.explanation: Kitab ki hal shuda misal ki tarah hypothesis testing ke steps par chalein: hypotheses, significance level, sample mean, standard deviation, t-value, decision rule, conclusion.

book_ref.quote: A school wants to check whether a new teaching method has improved students' marks.

steps: Step 1: H₀: naya method marks behtar nahin karta (μ = 60). H₁: naya method marks behtar karta hai (μ > 60).
Step 6: df = n − 1 = 5 − 1 = 4; t = 2.83 aur df = 4 ke liye one-tailed p-value taqreeban 0.024.
Step 7: p-value (0.024) < α (0.05), is liye null hypothesis radd.
blocks.final_answer: t ≈ 2.83, p ≈ 0.024 < 0.05: H₀ radd; naya revision method marks ko numayan tor par behtar karta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yeh one-tailed test hai kyunke H₁ sirf 'zyada' (μ > 60) kehta hai. Kitab ki misal mein bhi isi wajah se one-tailed p (taqreeban 0.000012) lena chahiye, chhapa hua 0.00002 two-tailed hai.

blocks.prompt:
11 Explain the F-test and the Chi-Square test, giving the use and formula of each (4). Two groups of students have marks with variances 20 and 8. Calculate the F-value and state how the decision is made (4). (8 marks)
(F-test aur Chi-Square test ko un ke istemal aur formula ke saath samjhayein (4). Students ke do groups ke marks ke variances 20 aur 8 hain. F-value nikalein aur batayein ke faisla kaise hota hai (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Advanced tests pechida data sambhalte hain aur gehra analysis dete hain; yeh sakht usoolon par chalte hain.
F-test: variances milata hai aur analysis of variance mein istemal hota hai. F = S₁²/S₂², jahan S₁² sample 1 aur S₂² sample 2 ka variance hai.
Chi-Square test: talluqat check karta hai aur categorical data ke saath istemal hota hai. χ² = Σ (Oᵢ − Eᵢ)²/Eᵢ, Oᵢ observed aur Eᵢ expected frequency.
steps: Nikali gayi F-value (2.5) ko F-table ki critical value se milaya jata hai.
Agar F critical value se aage (critical region mein) ho to variances mein numayan farq hai; warna nahin.
blocks.final_answer: F = 2.5; F-table ki critical value se mila kar faisla hota hai ke variances mein numayan farq hai ya nahin.

blocks.prompt:
12 Name the most suitable chart for each situation and justify it: (A) average marks of students taught by the old and new methods, (B) monthly attendance over a year, (C) percentage of students choosing each subject, (D) hours of study against marks (4). Explain how such visuals are linked with a hypothesis (4). (8 marks)
(Har soorat ke liye munasib chart batayein aur wajah dein: (A) purane aur naye method se parhne wale students ke ausat marks, (B) saal bhar ki mahana hazri, (C) har subject chunne wale students ka percentage, (D) parhai ke ghante aur marks (4). Samjhayein ke aise visuals hypothesis se kaise jorte hain (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Part 1: table dekhein.

Part 2:
1. Data visuals nataij ko seedha hypothesis se jorte hain; researchers tasveer mein dekh lete hain ke data hypothesis ki himayat karta hai ya use radd.
2. Comparison graph control aur experimental treatment groups ka farq dikha sakta hai, jaise case (A).
3. Line graphs ke trends peshgoi ki tasdeeq karte hain aur scatter plots hypothesis mein bayan talluqat pehchanne mein madad dete hain.
4. Tasveeri saboot mantiqi soch mazboot karta hai, is liye visualization hypotheses ki tasdeeq ya tardeed mein mazboot madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Bar charts are useful for comparing categories or groups.

rows: (A) Purane aur naye method ke marks
Bar chart: categories ya groups ka muqabla.
(B) Saal bhar ki mahana hazri
Line graph: waqt ke saath trends aur tabdeeliyan.
(C) Har subject ka percentage
Pie chart: hisse aur percentages.
(D) Parhai ke ghante aur marks
Scatter plot: do variables ka talluq.

blocks.prompt:
13 Explain the use of data visualization (i) before applying statistical tests and (ii) after testing, while interpreting and communicating results, with four points each (8). (8 marks)
(Data visualization ka istemal (i) statistical tests lagane se pehle aur (ii) testing ke baad, nataij ki tashreeh aur tarseel mein, chaar chaar nukaat ke saath samjhayein (8).)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Statistical tests se pehle:
1. Visualization raw data ko ba-maani tasveeri shakal deta hai.
2. Patterns, trends aur talluqat dekhne aur bare datasets samajhne mein madad deta hai jo sirf adad se mushkil hain.
3. Visual tools trends, distributions aur variations wazeh karte hain.
4. Outliers aur anomalies pehchanne mein madad; ghair mamooli patterns dikha kar ghaltiyan kam karta hai.

(ii) Testing ke baad:
1. Statistical findings ki behtar tashreeh aur nataij ki ghalat fehmi ka imkaan kam.
2. Charts aur graphs se groups ka farq aasani se milaya jata hai.
3. Tasveeri saboot de kar behtar faisla sazi.
4. Technical aur non-technical dono logon ke liye nataij ki tarseel aasan. Majmooi tor par visualization wazahat aur durusti barha kar hypothesis testing ko mazboot karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It supports better interpretation of statistical findings.

blocks.prompt:
14 Define bias (2). Name the type of bias in each case and say how it could be avoided: (A) an online survey about internet use is answered only by city students; (B) a study on sleep and health includes only university students; (C) an analyst reports only the months in which sales went up (6). (8 marks)
(Bias ki definition likhein (2). Har soorat mein bias ki qisam batayein aur bachao ka tareeqa likhein: (A) internet istemal ka online survey sirf shehri students ne bhara; (B) neend aur sehat ki study mein sirf university students shamil hain; (C) analyst sirf woh mahine batata hai jin mein sales barhi (6).)
blocks.explanation:
Bias data collection, analysis ya tashreeh mein na-munsifana asar hai jo ghalat ya gumrah kun nataij tak le ja sakta hai. Data collection mein yeh tab hota hai jab data tamam groups ki munsifana numaindagi na kare, mehdood sources ya na-munsifana sampling se; analysis mein zaati mafroozat bhi bias laate hain.

Table dekhein. Har soorat mein bias ko pehchan kar ehtiyat se data jama aur be-laag analysis se kam kiya jaye.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, careful data collection and objective analysis are necessary to ensure fairness.

rows: (A) Survey sirf shehri students ne bhara
Geographical bias (sirf shehri data sab ke liye). Bachao: shehri aur dehi dono ilaqon se data lein.
(B) Study mein sirf university students
Sampling bias (sample doosri umar ke groups ki numaindagi nahin karta). Bachao: har umar ke log shamil karein.
(C) Sirf barhti sales wale mahine bataye
Confirmation bias (sirf himayat wala data, mukhalif nataij nazar andaz). Bachao: tamam mahine batayein, selective reporting na karein.

blocks.prompt:
15 Explain how ethics applies at three stages of data science: (i) collecting data, (ii) building machine learning models, (iii) reporting results (6). Why are transparency and accountability essential? (2) (8 marks)
(Data science ke teen marahil par akhlaqiyat kaise lagu hoti hai samjhayein: (i) data jama karna, (ii) machine learning models banana, (iii) nataij batana (6). Transparency aur accountability kyun zaroori hain? (2))
blocks.explanation:
(i) Data jama karna: logon ki privacy aur raazdari ka ehtiram; durust ijazat (consent) se data lena aur sirf usi maqsad ke liye istemal; hassas data ko ghair mutalliqa rasai se bachana; data tamam groups ki munsifana numaindagi kare taake bias na ho.

(ii) Models banana: machine learning models imtiyaz (discrimination) se pak design hon; akhlaqi usool predictive models ka ghalat istemal rokte hain; model design ki shaffafiyat users ka aitmaad banati hai.

(iii) Nataij batana: nataij imandari se, baghair mubalighe ya hera pheri ke; data aur analysis ki hudood wazeh bayan karna; gumrah kun visuals aur selective reporting se bachna.

Transparency aur accountability har marhale mein zaroori hain kyunke akhlaqi tareeqe data par mabni faislon mein insaaf, durusti aur aitmaad laate hain, jab ke kamzor akhlaqi maiyar data ka ghalat istemal aur logon ko nuqsan dete hain. Akhlaqi shaoor awam ka aitmaad qaim rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Sensitive data should be protected from unauthorized access.

blocks.prompt:
16 A teacher tests whether a new teaching method improves marks and finds p = 0.03 with α = 0.05. (i) Interpret this result (3). (ii) Write a conclusion connected to the hypothesis (2). (iii) A student writes: 'The method is the best in the world and will work in every school.' Give three reasons why this conclusion is wrong (3). (8 marks)
(Teacher jaanchta hai ke naya teaching method marks behtar karta hai ya nahin aur α = 0.05 par p = 0.03 aata hai. (i) Is nateeje ki tashreeh karein (3). (ii) Hypothesis se jura conclusion likhein (2). (iii) Aik student likhta hai: 'Yeh method duniya ka behtareen hai aur har school mein kaam karega.' Yeh conclusion ghalat hone ki teen wajuhat dein (3).)
blocks.explanation:
(i) H₀: naye method ka koi asar nahin; H₁: yeh marks behtar karta hai. p-value (0.03) α (0.05) se chhota hai, is liye nateeja ittefaq se aana mushkil hai aur H₀ radd kiya ja sakta hai. Tashreeh karte waqt data ka context dekhna zaroori hai.

(ii) Conclusion: null hypothesis radd; statistical saboot hai ke naye teaching method ne shayad students ki karkardagi behtar ki, is liye data H₁ ki himayat karta hai.

(iii) Ghalat is liye hai:
1. Conclusion sirf analyze kiye gaye data par ho; test ne sirf is sample ko purane method se milaya, 'duniya' ko nahin.
2. Yeh asal hypothesis se aage nikal gaya; conclusion seedha hypothesis se jura aur test results se sabit ho, zaati raaye se nahin.
3. Yeh mubaligha hai aur data ki hudood nazar andaz karta hai; nataij imandari se, baghair mubalighe ke hon, aur ghalat tashreeh ghalat conclusions deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Clear explanation of results is essential for accuracy.

blocks.prompt:
17 Write five rules for presenting findings clearly (5). Using these rules, write a short clear report of the book's worked example on the new teaching method (10 students, mean 77 against the previous average 70, t ≈ 7.93) (3). (8 marks)
(Findings wazeh pesh karne ke paanch usool likhein (5). In usoolon ke mutabiq kitab ki naye teaching method wali hal shuda misal (10 students, mean 77 bamuqabla pichhla ausat 70, t ≈ 7.93) ki mukhtasar wazeh report likhein (3).)
blocks.explanation:
Usool:
1. Nataij mantiqi aur munazzam tareeqe se tarteeb dein.
2. Wazahat ke liye tables, charts aur graphs istemal karein.
3. Technical jargon ki jagah aasan zaban.
4. Behtar samajh ke liye ahem nukaat numayan karein.
5. Findings ko asal hypothesis se jorein, sirf analyze kiye gaye data par rakhein aur hudood imandari se batayein.

Report:
Sawal: kya naye teaching method ne marks behtar kiye? (H₀: μ = 70; H₁: μ > 70; α = 0.05.)
Nateeja: naye method se parhne wale 10 students ka ausat 77 tha, pichhle ausat 70 se 7 zyada (t ≈ 7.93, df = 9, one-tailed p ≈ 0.000012, 0.05 se bohat kam).
Conclusion: null hypothesis radd; naya teaching method students ke marks numayan tor par behtar karta hai. Hadd: sample mein sirf 10 students hain.

book_ref.quote: Well-presented findings make the research more effective and useful.
